Convert stop times to frequencies

Source: R/stop_times_to_frequencies.R
stop_times_to_frequencies.Rd

Converts scheduled trips, described only in stop_times, into frequency-based trips, described in frequencies. Trips that follow the same route and sequence of stops are summarised, in each hour of the day, by a single template trip and the headway between their departures. This is a lossy approximation of the original schedule.

Usage

stop_times_to_frequencies(gtfs, trip_id = NULL)

Arguments

gtfs

A GTFS object, as created by read_gtfs().

trip_id

A character vector including the trip_ids to be converted. If NULL (the default), the function converts all trips listed in stop_times that are not already listed in frequencies.

Value

A GTFS object with updated frequencies, stop_times and trips tables (and transfers, when present). If the given GTFS object has no frequencies table, one is created.

Details

Trips are grouped by route_id, service_id, direction_id and shape_id (the last two only if present in trips) and by their sequence of stops, as identified by get_stop_times_patterns(). Each group is split into one-hour slots of the clock, from HH:00:00 (included) to the next HH:00:00 (excluded), by the earliest departure_time of each trip in stop_times, regardless of stop_sequence (so times after midnight written as "00:30:00" instead of "24:30:00" misplace the trip). Slots after midnight are kept as such (e.g. "25:00:00" to "26:00:00").

In each slot with n trips, the trip with the earliest departure (ties broken by trip_id) becomes the template and keeps its trip_id and its trips and stop_times entries. A frequencies entry is added for it, from the start to the end of the slot, with headway_secs = ceiling(3600 / n) and exact_times = 0. The other trips are removed from trips, stop_times and transfers; transfers entries of the template now apply to all of its departures. Other tables that may refer to trips, such as attributions and translations, are not changed.

Slots with a single trip are also converted. Only the trips in trip_id are grouped and converted; other trips are never removed, even if they share a group and a slot with converted ones. Trips already listed in frequencies (with a warning, if listed in trip_id), trips not listed in trips and trips without any departure_time are left unchanged.

Converting the result back with frequencies_to_stop_times() yields the same number of trips in each slot with at most 60 trips (approximately the same otherwise), evenly spaced from the start of the slot.

Existing _secs columns in stop_times and frequencies (e.g. created with convert_time_to_seconds()) are used as-is and filled in for the new frequencies entries.

Examples

library(dplyr)

data_path <- system.file("extdata/ber_gtfs.zip", package = "gtfstools")
gtfs <- read_gtfs(data_path)

# converts all trips
converted_gtfs <- stop_times_to_frequencies(gtfs)
nrow(gtfs$trips)
#> [1] 348
nrow(converted_gtfs$trips)
#> [1] 340
head(converted_gtfs$frequencies)
#>      trip_id start_time end_time headway_secs exact_times
#>       <char>     <char>   <char>        <int>       <int>
#> 1: 143765725   05:00:00 06:00:00         3600           0
#> 2: 143765729   06:00:00 07:00:00         3600           0
#> 3: 143765727   10:00:00 11:00:00         3600           0
#> 4: 143765726   14:00:00 15:00:00         3600           0
#> 5: 143765724   16:00:00 17:00:00         3600           0
#> 6: 143765723   17:00:00 18:00:00         3600           0

# converts only the trips of one route
route_trips <- gtfs$trips |>
  filter(route_id == gtfs$trips$route_id[1]) |>
  pull(trip_id)
converted_gtfs <- stop_times_to_frequencies(gtfs, route_trips)

# converting back yields evenly spaced scheduled trips
back_gtfs <- frequencies_to_stop_times(converted_gtfs)
